summary: All 8 UI-facing acceptance criteria for the AION mobile demo verified via named browser checks. No backend criteria applicable (frontend-only demo, no persistent data, no auth).

checks.criterion: AION arayüzü public URL’de ekranın tamamını doldurur
checks.name: aion-fullscreen-mobile-shell
checks.evidence: 390x844 viewport: assistant-home-screen boundingBox x=0,y=0,width>=388,height>=840; no outer card padding/rounded frame

checks.name: aion-turkish-branding-visible
checks.evidence: mobile-brand text 'AION', greeting-heading 'Bugün sana nasıl yardımcı olabilirim?', sidebar brand-mark 'AION' all visible

checks.criterion: Mobil navigasyon açılır menü olarak çalışır
checks.name: aion-mobile-drawer-navigation
checks.evidence: Drawer opened via mobile-menu-button revealed Ana Sayfa/Keşfet/Gelen Kutusu/Arşiv/Ayarlar/Çıkış Yap/Hendricks profile; selecting Keşfet closed drawer (is-mobile-open removed) and set status 'Keşfet seçildi'

checks.criterion: Mobil sohbet girişi dokunmaya uygun ve erişilebilirdir
checks.name: aion-mobile-composer-touch-accessible
checks.evidence: chat-message-input and chat-send-button visible, positioned in lower ~70% of 844px viewport, send button >=24x24px touch target

checks.name: aion-message-send-demo-flow
checks.evidence: Typed 'tscheck-mesaj-gonderme-testi', clicked send: input cleared, sent-message-preview shows 'Son istem' + text, interaction-status = 'Mesajın AION için hazır'

checks.name: aion-quick-actions-fill-prompt
checks.evidence: quick-action-surprise-button filled input with 'Bugün için beni şaşırtacak yaratıcı bir fikir ver'; quick-action-summarise-button filled 'Bunu benim için özetle: '

checks.criterion: Composer yardımcı kontrolleri Türkçedir ve çalışır
checks.name: aion-composer-controls-turkish
checks.evidence: chat-import-file-button 'Dosya ekle', chat-tools-button 'Araçlar' visible; clicking tools opened Turkish popover with title 'Araçlar' and copy text

checks.name: aion-clean-mobile-flow-no-errors
checks.evidence: Walked drawer open/select, quick action, tools popover, send flow while monitoring page 'response' events - zero responses with status>=400; no thrown console errors during flow
